aliases.description: Additional namespaces the included tasks also register under.

excludes.description: Fragment task names dropped before flattening or namespace registration.

file.description: Path to the tooling fragment, resolved relative to the file that declares the include and contained under the app root.

flatten.description: When true, included task names register unprefixed instead of under the include namespace.

internal.description: When true, every task contributed by this include is registered hidden.

optional.description: When true, a missing fragment file is skipped instead of failing the load.

vars.description: Literal vars applied to every included task unless the task defines its own value.
